name: learning-to-skill
description: Write the lessons from a session into the instruction files your agents read, such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Copilot's instructions, or a skill's SKILL.md, in the right place and without duplicates, only after you approve the diff

interface.longDescription: Turns a correction or lesson from the current session into one short rule in the instruction files your agents read in every later session. It lists the project's AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, and skill SKILL.md files, says which of Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Gemini CLI read each one, following links and @ imports, and points out repeated lines and files that have grown too long. Before writing, it checks that no line already says the same, then shows the change as a diff with a fingerprint, and writes exactly that change only after you approve it, refusing if the file changed in between. It uses only Python, sends nothing, keeps no files of its own, and never commits.
defaultPrompt: Remember what we learned in this session for next time
